name: 48746 · Millington, MI
findings: ZIP 48746 (Millington) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48746 (Millington) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
